mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 150k signals stronger employment growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1,000k units signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags on corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST falls below 1,000k for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in Industrial Production below 98.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls below 98.0 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that raises wage pressures and inflation risk, prompting higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 5.0% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures below 1.0% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings growth and increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS growth falls below -1.0% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in CPI below 1.5% signals easing inflation and reduced monetary policy tightening risk, which lowers discount rates and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when CPI falls below 1.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
